d:
SpiceJet is facing a deepening financial and operational crisis, with flight cancellations and delays leaving passengers stranded and frustrated. Reports suggest that employees have been struggling with delayed salaries, while payments to suppliers remain pending. Several aircraft are grounded, raising concerns about the airline’s ability to maintain regular operations.
The DGCA has issued a show-cause notice to SpiceJet over operational lapses and passenger inconvenience. With the airline planning to raise ₹5,500 crore, questions remain about its financial stability and future.
